title: Pow(x, n)
statement: Compute x raised to the power n, where n may be negative. Multiplying in a loop is too slow for large exponents.
hints: A negative exponent means take the reciprocal. Careful: negating int.MinValue overflows, so widen to long first.
Exponentiation by squaring halves the exponent each step: x^n is (x^(n/2)) squared, times one extra x when n is odd.
That turns O(n) multiplications into O(log n). Answers are compared with a 1e-5 tolerance.
